name: XOOMAR market data API
description: JSON and CSV over plain GET. Every response carries the same envelope: data, updatedAt, source, docs, license, attribution and meta, whose sourceAttribution line credits the publisher of the data. No key needed to start: 10 requests a minute per IP without a key and 30 a minute with a free account key, with at least six months of history. Data terms: https://xoomar.com/terms. Credit XOOMAR with a link to the dataset page when you republish the data.
